description: This file is a C header defining function prototypes for managing value change events in a system, specifically adding, removing, and closing property nodes related to rbus handles.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_AddPropertyNode
methods.description: Adds a property node to an rbus handle for value change notifications.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_RemovePropertyNode
methods.description: Removes a property node from an rbus handle.

methods.name: rbusValueChange_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the rbus handle.
